tasks.build: rm -rf dist && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir dist web/index.html && cp -R web/public/. dist/ && cp config/production.json dist/config.json
tasks.check: deno check web/src supabase/functions tests scripts && deno lint && deno fmt --check
tasks.test:reset: supabase db reset && scripts/local-env.sh && deno run -A --env-file=.env.local scripts/wait-ready.ts
tasks.gen:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema api,service > supabase/functions/_shared/db.types.ts && deno fmt supabase/functions/_shared/db.types.ts
